title: Cave Living
description: A mod that adds many items, blocks, recipes, etc. to allow you to live in caves exclusively. WIP
body:
### Cave Living
Cave living adds many blocks, items, recipes, and structures to allow players to survive exclusively underground, never surfacing.

<details>
<summary>List of Features</summary>

- Arborite: Mine Arborite Ore to get Arborite and Barkit. These are used to make Arbor Wood. Or, you could punch the ore to get Arborite Shards, used to make Arborite before getting a pickaxe.
- Sugar Ore: Mine Sugar Ore to get Sugar, used to craft Sugarcane.
- Rotten Flesh -> Leather: Smelt Rotten Flesh to Dried Rotten Flesh in a furnace, then again to get leather. Or, use a Smoker to turn the Rotten Flesh directly into Leather.

</details>
This mod is still HEAVILY Work-In-Progress, with many planned features not added yet.
